newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 25.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iranian Revolutionary Guard threatens to wage war against the United States if it attacked Tehran.
- Saudi Arabian navy receives British-built minesweeper.
- Saudi businessman Prince al-Waleed plans to build a hotel in Beirut.
- Western reports speak of disappearance of the Saudi dissident Osama Bin Laden.
- General manager of the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development says the Egyptian government will in November seek financing facilities for projects in Egypt from Arab funds.
